title: Crypto trend continuation after volatility expansion
thesis: Large-cap crypto assets may continue intraday trend moves after volatility expansion when pullbacks hold above the session VWAP.
market_intuition: When BTC and ETH expand range early in the session and then hold above VWAP, continuation may outperform mean reversion for the next several hours.
entry_idea: Enter long after range expansion if price pulls back toward VWAP and closes back above it.
exit_idea: Exit on fixed R target, close below VWAP, or end of session.
risk_assumption: Fixed fractional risk with a volatility-adjusted stop below VWAP.
cost_slippage_assumption: Use explicit exchange taker fees and 3-5 bps slippage stress.
data_source: Exchange OHLCV plus tradeable mark/index context where available.
disproof_condition: Reject if expectancy disappears after costs or if edge is concentrated in fewer than five outlier trades.

clarification_answers.q_session: Use UTC session boundaries for the first test.
clarification_answers.q_benchmark: Compare to buy-and-hold and randomized entry with same holding period.
